highlights_headline: Upcoming SkiaSharp packages will ship compiler-generated XML documentation beside their managed assemblies.
highlights_body: Public API documentation now originates in C# XML comments, making package reference documentation consistent with the maintained source.

bullets.lead: Package XML documentation is generated from source
bullets.detail: NuGet packages include compiler-generated XML documentation, with public API remarks authored alongside the C# declarations.

bullets.lead: Generated interop bindings are organized by type
bullets.detail: P/Invoke declarations are split into per-type generated files without changing the managed API surface.
